name: Barbanza e Iria

known.via: English Wikipedia "Barbanza e Iria" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: Spain's regional wine tier, below DO.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Galician vino de la tierra covering municipalities in A Coruña and Pontevedra provinces, such as Padrón, Boiro and Ribeira. It sits one step below the DO level and gained that status.
